questions.q: Paper craft can be best defined as the art of:
options: Making solid furniture out of hard wood.
Creating two or three-dimensional objects using paper or card as the primary medium.
Recycling plastic waste into decorative items.
Weaving fabrics on a traditional loom.
questions.explain: Paper craft is a creative activity that primarily utilizes paper and cardboards to make aesthetic and functional items, such as models, greeting cards, and kites.
questions.exam: BECE Cultural & Creative Arts: Crafts, Media & Painting
questions.subject: Cultural and Creative Arts

questions.q: In paper craft, when a square piece of paper is folded in half directly from one corner to the opposite diagonal corner, it results in a:
questions.explain: Folding a square paper diagonally brings two opposite corners together, instantly creating a triangular shape.
questions.exam: BECE Cultural & Creative Arts: Crafts, Media & Painting
questions.subject: Cultural and Creative Arts

questions.q: Which of the following describes the 'Plaiting' method in paper craft?
options: Melting paper into a liquid form for painting.
Intertwining or weaving strips of paper together to form a patterned surface.
Folding paper into tiny triangular pieces only.
Burning the edges of the paper for a decorative effect.
questions.explain: Plaiting in paper craft involves weaving overlapping strips of paper (much like hair plaiting or basket weaving) to create textured, patterned surfaces or objects like paper baskets.
questions.exam: BECE Cultural & Creative Arts: Crafts, Media & Painting
questions.subject: Cultural and Creative Arts

questions.q: Which basic hand tool is essential for accurately dividing and shaping paper during paper craft production?
questions.explain: A pair of scissors (or a utility knife/blade) is the primary cutting tool used in paper craft to cleanly divide, trim, and shape paper and cardboard.
questions.exam: BECE Cultural & Creative Arts: Crafts, Media & Painting
questions.subject: Cultural and Creative Arts

questions.q: What type of folding involves bending the paper such that the resulting shape maintains equal opposite sides and right angles, resembling a box?
questions.explain: A rectangular fold is achieved by folding a paper across its width or length, creating a shape with four straight sides and four right angles where opposite sides are equal.
questions.exam: BECE Cultural & Creative Arts: Crafts, Media & Painting
questions.subject: Cultural and Creative Arts

questions.q: Why is the application of color important in the finishing stages of a paper craft project?
options: It makes the paper heavier and unbreakable.
It prevents the paper from ever catching fire.
It enhances the aesthetic value and visual appeal of the craft.
It turns the paper back into wood.
questions.explain: Colors applied through paints, crayons, or markers serve to beautify the craft work, making it visually pleasing and realistic.
questions.exam: BECE Cultural & Creative Arts: Crafts, Media & Painting
questions.subject: Cultural and Creative Arts

questions.q: Which of the following is NOT a recognized method of folding in paper craft as per standard craft techniques?
questions.explain: Square, triangular, and rectangular folds are standard methods used to manipulate paper. 'Liquid folding' is non-existent as paper is solid.
questions.exam: BECE Cultural & Creative Arts: Crafts, Media & Painting
questions.subject: Cultural and Creative Arts

questions.q: In making a paper kite, which combination of materials and tools is most appropriate?
options: Lightweight paper, bamboo sticks, glue, and thread
questions.explain: A kite requires lightweight materials like thin paper (or nylon), light structural supports (bamboo or sticks), adhesive (glue), and flying string (thread).
questions.exam: BECE Cultural & Creative Arts: Crafts, Media & Painting
questions.subject: Cultural and Creative Arts

questions.q: When executing a 'Square fold' from a rectangular sheet of paper, the primary goal is to ensure that:
options: All four sides of the resulting shape are perfectly equal in length.
The paper becomes a multi-layered circle.
The paper is cut into long thin strips.
The paper is crumpled into a ball.
questions.explain: A square has four equal sides. Creating a square fold means adjusting or folding the paper until a perfect square with equal-length sides is formed.
questions.exam: BECE Cultural & Creative Arts: Crafts, Media & Painting
questions.subject: Cultural and Creative Arts

questions.q: The traditional Japanese art of paper folding, which is a highly sophisticated form of paper craft, is popularly known as:
questions.explain: Origami is the internationally recognized art of folding flat sheets of paper into intricate 3D sculptures without cutting or gluing.
